A SpaceX Starlink launch (Group 10‑19) is slated for today at 11:07 a.m. EDT from Cape Canaveral, carrying 29 satellites on a Falcon 9 booster on its 18th flight.  The National Weather Service has issued a moderate rip‑current warning for Brevard and neighboring counties through early this morning, and police have taken 23‑year‑old Tyjah Bellinger into custody on a first‑degree‑murder charge after a fatal shooting in Port St. John. ### Good Morning  
Good morning. It’s Monday, August 10, 2026. Here’s what’s happening.

### Top National Stories  
The Pentagon is urging defense contractors to file accelerated production plans within 21 days, citing the ongoing war with Iran and sharply reduced Patriot and THAAD interceptor stocks.  The department’s request accompanies a White House proposal to raise the defense budget to $1.5 trillion for the next fiscal year [^7].

### Business & the Economy  
The sources reviewed did not contain a distinct market move or economic data release in the last day.

### Around the World  
No international incidents or geopolitical developments were reported in the sources accessed for the past 24 hours.

### Space Industry  
SpaceX’s next Starlink mission, Group 10‑19, is scheduled for today at 11:07 a.m. EDT from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral.  The flight will deploy 29 satellites and uses a Falcon 9 booster on its 18th flight [^1][^2].

### Artificial Intelligence & Tech  
The sources did not include a new AI model release or major technology announcement in the last 24 hours.

### Around the Space Coast  
The National Weather Service has issued a moderate rip‑current alert for Brevard, Volusia, Indian River, St. Lucie, and Martin counties, effective through 2:00 a.m. EDT this morning [^3].  
In Port St. John, police arrested 23‑year‑old Tyjah Bellinger after a shooting investigation; he has been denied bond on a first‑degree‑murder charge [^14].

That’s the news for Monday, August 10, 2026. Drive safely.
